text:
About 0.6 ha of tree cover was lost on this 17.6 ha property in 2022, roughly 3.4% of its area. The Hansen/UMD data show the loss, and it is corroborated: later years were observed, and the JRC 2020 map agrees that the area was forest.

The national forest map (MGAP 2021) puts about 0.5 ha of that area in native forest. The remaining 0.1 ha is outside mapped forest, and none of it is planted forest. So the native forest affected is roughly 0.5 ha, about 2.8% of the property. That figure comes from a 2021 map overlay, not a direct measurement of native-forest loss. A further 0.2 ha of loss in small patches (under 0.5 ha) was seen but not counted as an event.

This shows tree-cover loss only. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, the cause, legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
